title: Replace Privacy & Safety page with app-store compliant Privacy Policy (My Health Buddy)

requirements.summary: Fully rewrite the existing Grown-ups “Privacy & Safety” page into a worldwide, app-store compliant Privacy Policy for a children’s app with friendly, parent-readable English.
acceptanceCriteria: The existing page at frontend/src/pages/grownups/PrivacySafetyPage.tsx is fully rewritten (old content removed) into a Privacy Policy intended for a children’s app on Google Play and Apple App Store Kids Category.
Language is simple enough for parents to understand, with short paragraphs and a child-safe friendly tone while remaining legally clear.
Text does not mention or rely on any region-specific assumptions and is written for worldwide use.

file_operations.description: Replace all existing “Privacy & Safety” copy with a complete Privacy Policy for a children’s app in English, using short, friendly, legally clear paragraphs and avoiding region-specific assumptions. Use existing shadcn-ui Card/Button components already imported for readable sectioning; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Set the Privacy Policy page title and render the policy as distinct, scannable sections with headings in the exact required order.
acceptanceCriteria: ScreenLayout title for the page is exactly “Privacy Policy – My Health Buddy”.
All required sections appear as distinct headings in the exact order specified.
Each section is visually separated (e.g., separate cards or consistent spacing/dividers) and easy to scan.

file_operations.description: Update ScreenLayout title to exactly “Privacy Policy – My Health Buddy” and restructure content into clearly separated sections (e.g., Card blocks or consistent dividers/spacing) with headings in this exact order: No Personal Data Collection, Offline Use, Children’s Privacy, Data Storage, Medical Disclaimer, Third-Party Services, Changes, Contact, Ownership. Use existing shadcn-ui Card for consistent visual separation; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Ensure the “No Personal Data Collection” section explicitly lists all specified data types as not collected, in plain language.
acceptanceCriteria: The section explicitly lists all the following as not collected: names, email, location, contacts, photos, microphone recordings, health data, analytics, identifiers, cookies, tracking.
The wording is unambiguous that no collection occurs.

file_operations.description: In the “No Personal Data Collection” section, explicitly state the app does NOT collect: names, email, location, contacts, photos, microphone recordings, health data, analytics, identifiers, cookies, or tracking—using plain, unambiguous wording. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Explain in the “Offline Use” section that the app works fully offline and nothing leaves the device.
acceptanceCriteria: The policy states the app works completely offline.
The policy states that nothing leaves the device.

file_operations.description: In the “Offline Use” section, state clearly that the app works completely offline and that nothing leaves the device. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add a “Children’s Privacy” section stating intended supervised use and COPPA/GDPR-K compliance rationale due to no personal data collection.
acceptanceCriteria: The policy explicitly mentions COPPA and GDPR-K compliance rationale as “because no personal data is collected”.
The policy states the app is designed for children with parent/teacher/carer supervision.

file_operations.description: In the “Children’s Privacy” section, state the app is designed for children with parent/teacher/carer supervision and that it complies with COPPA and GDPR-K because no personal data is collected. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Explain in the “Data Storage” section that selections stay on-device and can be reset anytime.
acceptanceCriteria: The policy states selections are stored locally on the device only.
The policy states saved selections/data can be reset at any time.

file_operations.description: In the “Data Storage” section, explain that selections remain locally on the device only and can be reset anytime. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Clarify in “Medical Disclaimer” that the app is a communication tool and not medical advice.
acceptanceCriteria: The policy states the app is a communication tool.
The policy states it is not medical advice.

file_operations.description: In the “Medical Disclaimer” section, state that the app is a communication tool and not medical advice, keeping the tone gentle and clear. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: State in “Third-Party Services” that there are no ads, analytics SDKs, tracking, or third-party sharing.
acceptanceCriteria: The section explicitly states: no ads, no analytics SDKs, no tracking, and no third-party sharing.

file_operations.description: In the “Third-Party Services” section, explicitly state: no ads, no analytics SDKs, no tracking, and no third-party sharing. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Include a “Changes” section noting the policy may update if app features change.
acceptanceCriteria: The policy includes a Changes section stating the policy may be updated if features change.

file_operations.description: Add/update the “Changes” section to state the policy may be updated if app features change. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Include the exact support email in the “Contact” section.
acceptanceCriteria: The Contact section includes the email address exactly “support@myhealthbuddy.app”.

file_operations.description: In the “Contact” section, include the placeholder email address exactly: support@myhealthbuddy.app. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Include the exact ownership line in the “Ownership” section.
acceptanceCriteria: The Ownership section includes the provided ownership line exactly as written, including the em dash.

file_operations.description: In the “Ownership” section, include exactly: “© Gabriella Gayle — My Health Buddy and Luma character are original creations.” Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Update the Grown-ups Area navigation button label to “Privacy Policy” while keeping navigation target unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: In frontend/src/pages/grownups/GrownUpsAreaPage.tsx, the button that navigates to 'grownups-privacy' is labeled “Privacy Policy”.
Navigation destination remains 'grownups-privacy' and continues to work.

file_operations.description: Change the button text for the navigation action that calls onNavigate('grownups-privacy') from “Privacy & Safety” to “Privacy Policy”, without altering the navigation destination. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
